title: Async input and output composition
api_or_output: ParseAsync, ReadAsync, LoadAsync, SaveAsync, writer async methods

acceptance.description: Add real async I/O for SAX/reader/DOM/writer/save with synchronous callbacks and cancellation; no Task.Run wrappers.
Use a controlled stream requiring awaits/short reads; test cancellation, errors, no async-void callbacks and sync/async equality.
Demonstrate the deliverable using only verified dependencies and this task; record actual API/output files and checks at the tested revision. Preserve earlier milestone behavior.

handoff.summary: Integration join over separately owned async writer, DOM serialization, and async input children; original product A1/A2/A3 retained.
